items.title: CNN发展总结
items.content: CNN发展总结 正在学习李沐老师的d2l课程，梳理一下提到的几个标志性的CNN的逻辑以及发展的逻辑。 1 LeNet LeNet是最早的卷积神经网络，引入了卷积层、池化层等等。其架构如下： 那时的汇聚层、激活函数还是AvergePool和Sigmoid/Tanh，并非后来实践表明表现更好的ReLU和MaxPooling。 2 AlexNet 与LeNet思路类似，在imageNet比赛中取得了不错的成绩，证明了更深更大的模型可以有非常好的效果 更深的模型层数 卷积通道数目巨大，卷积窗口更大 激活函数从Sigmoid/Tanh改成ReLU 通过Dropout全连接层控制模型复杂度 使用大量增强数据：翻转、裁切、变色 其架构如下： 3 使用块的网络（VGG） 在AlexNet的实现中，我们可以意识到两件事： 更深更大的神经网络确实可以有更好的效果 有很多层的组合（例如卷积层+池化层）反复出现 因此为了方便构建模块化地构建更大的网络，我们可以将一系列“层”定义一个“块”，以“块”为基本单位之一构建网络。 4 网络中的网络（NiN） VGG把神经网络的规模做得非常巨大，但是此时又暴露出了内存/显存占用巨大的问题——尤其是卷积层之后的第一个全连接层，因输入输出的维度都巨大，参数的数量也巨大。 为了改善存储占用的问题，NiN网络中使用了使用NiN块与GAP层。 NiN块中使用了1$\times$1的卷积层，相当于通道维度的全连接层，不仅可以减少参数量，而且可以减少过拟合 Global Average Pooling （GAP）层被用来代替全连接层，减少了存储的参数的数量 4 含并⾏连结的⽹络（GoogLeNet） 有了NiN之后，我们有了控制网络总参数量的工具。由此，我们可以构建更深、更复杂的网络。 GoogLeNet的想法很自然： 在我们构建了足够强大的线形网络之后，我们也可以构建一些并行的有分支的网络 在纠结要用哪一种卷积参数的时候，我们可以选择全都要 GoogLeNet也借鉴了NiN网络： 使用了1$\times$1的卷积网络降维通道 使用GAP层，代替全连接层 在深度的维度上拼接，实现了并行输出的整合 首先定义了一个Inception块 其中白底的仅仅是用于调整深度，深紫底的才是实际提取特征的层。 由此可以构建出GoogLeNet # 5 残差网络（ResNet） 超深神经网络存在两大挑战： 参数量庞大，计算和存储开销大。 深度增加导致梯度消失/梯度爆炸，训练困难。 前者在前面的模型中已经解决，后者ResNet可以解决。 ResNet的核心思想如下： 更复杂的网络应包含原有的更简单网络，保证性能至少不劣于浅层网络。 引入残差函数 $F(x) = f(x) - x$，将学习目标改写为：$f(x) = F(x) + x$ 残差函数的作用主要想概括为以下两点： 保证“性能不劣于浅层网络” 当 $F(x) = 0$ 时，网络输出即退化为恒等映射 $y = x$ 网络可以在恒等映射附近开始学习，使训练更容易 如果$F(x)$对于结果不好，那$F(x)$拿不到梯度，还是在0附近 梯度传递优势 前向传播时，恒等映射提供了直接捷径 反向传播时，梯度可以沿 $+x$ 这条捷径无衰减地传回，缓解梯度消失问题 ResNet最大的挑战是：相加的时候捷径的形状不同。 通道数量不同 通过增加$1\times1$卷积层来控制通道数 维度不同 通过卷积核为1，有stride的卷积层来控制维度 ResNet基本结构的图示如下： 6 稠密连接网络（DenseNet） DenseNet 继承了ResNet的思想，将其进一步发展。 如果说ResNet是泰勒展开的一阶近似，那DenseNet就是高阶近似。DenseNet讲更多的过往的层传到现在的结果。 DenseNet主要由两种块构成： 稠密块 大量旁路，为了将这么多结果整合在一起，DenseNet像GoogLeNet一样，在通道维度把结果拼接起来。 过渡块 经过稠密块后通道数巨大，因此使用$1\times1$卷积层减小通道数，使用平均汇聚层减小维数。

items.title: 影评：《南京照相馆》
items.content: 按下快门，扣下扳机 第一次发现按下快门和扣下扳机这么像。打开机身，打开枪膛；放入胶片，塞进子弹；按下快门，扣下扳机：前者定格世界，后者定格生命——都是永恒，不过前者创造，后者湮灭。 影片的开头就用这一段蒙太奇展示了两者的相似性，伊藤秀夫拍下杀人的照片，日军新兵杀人。伊藤秀夫眼中似乎有同情与震撼，甚至还“救”了阿昌——他叫阿昌“朋友”，给阿昌报名表通行证，看似同情中国的动摇者、庇护中国人的善人——影片开头似乎在用尽方法欺骗说服观众：伊藤秀夫是好人。伪善的伏笔暗藏其中：梦想是继承参加甲午战争的爷爷攻入中国、通行证上面的“有效期两日”。或许他有过人性中朴素的对恶行的排斥与对自己所做的动摇，我不认为他毫无人性，但军国主义将他洗脑让他罔顾人性的忠告，他从未正视人性与自己所做所为的矛盾，陷入阿伦特所说的“无思”的状态。 照相馆是一个很巧妙的切入点，在这个特殊的时候，照片的媒介必须通过照相馆才能刊出，主角一行也由此看到了真实的、血淋淋的南京。但更加令人触目的是，照片里的不是一群陌生人，而是一群街坊邻居。昨日身边活生生的人，成了今日照片里惨死的人，让人感到倒吸凉气但又愤怒——老金说：“我们不能当汉奸。”于是这一行人里，没有一个汉奸， 林毓秀和小孩活了下来，传出了照片；老金妻女死得意外，且因死亡毫无意义，更加令人扼腕愤怒；老金与阿昌用自己的方式，物理、精神上都算是出了口恶气；宋存义用自己的生命换来了其他人的活命，用南京城墙砸死了日本人。只有汉奸死得像狗一样。 《鬼子来了》中，日本军队在影片开头给小孩糖，在最后杀光了小孩。伊藤秀夫一开始给了阿昌生存——连给生存的权利竟然都能算是恩赐了，甚至或许真的对于阿昌产生了一种近似友谊的情感。但是在长官的催促下，在他自己的军国主义思想下，他拒绝了人性，并且要用杀死阿昌来彻底斩断自己的人性。可怜老金至死也不知道自己的妻女已经死了。伊藤秀夫最后冲进照相馆的时候依然在撒谎：“我当你是朋友。”无牵挂无生路的阿昌说实话：“我们不是朋友。”一句“中日亲善”贯穿始终。 一般来说，我不爱看主旋律抗战片——反而是被一些手撕鬼子的无端滑稽和强行升华的价值观消磨掉了忍耐力。好的电影想要传达它的情感与价值不需要直白地喊出来，而是让观众自己滑向那种情感，自己解读自己的价值。南京照相馆最后的煽情使用了大量蒙太奇——照片本身就是很好的蒙太奇的桥梁。老金换进伊藤秀夫胶卷的南京市民日常胶卷和南京市民被杀的镜头不断切换，普通生活的美好以这样一种方式在观众眼前被撕碎。日常胶卷掺杂在屠杀胶卷里，伊藤秀夫看后暴怒——被撕碎的美好用这样一种方式完成了自杀式的反击，杀死了伊藤秀夫。伊藤秀夫曾说：“支那人的照片不重要。”支那人的照片杀死了他，他自己的照片杀死了日本军官。 《辛德勒的名单》中，德国军官曾试图枪杀犹太人，扣下扳机之后几次发现枪坏了，最终不杀了，最终他也类似地像个玩具一样被杀死。同样是报应，胜利后，还是在南京，曾经草菅人命的日本军官在同一个地方被枪毙，同样是快门和扳机，这次照片和子弹成功相遇了。 片尾曲，昔日的南京照片放到今日同样的地方，如今国泰民安，不见昔日日寇，只见车水马龙，感慨万分。 也在想，这部电影有可能出海嘛？电影本身质量不低，《辛德勒的名单》、《拯救大兵瑞恩》甚至《壮志凌云》都能够在国际上享有自己的话语权，那《南京照相馆》有可能嘛？ 看完电影，骑车回家，下大暴雨了，淋了一身湿——也好久没有淋过雨了。上海在下雨，南京也在下雨吧。
items.content_en: Press the shutter, pull the trigger I first realized how similar pressing a camera shutter is to pulling a gun trigger. Open the camera body, open the gun chamber; insert film, load bullets; press the shutter, pull the trigger: the former freezes a moment of the world, the latter freezes a life — both create eternity, but the former gives birth to something new while the latter leads to annihilation. The film opens with this montage to show the similarity between the two: Ito Hideo takes photos of killings, while a Japanese recruit commits murder. There seems to be sympathy and shock in Ito Hideo’s eyes; he even “saves” A Chang — calling him “friend” and giving him a registration form and pass. He appears to be a compassionate figure who takes pity on Chinese collaborators and protects the Chinese. The opening of the film seems to go to great lengths to deceive and persuade the audience: Ito Hideo is a good person. Hidden clues of hypocrisy lie within: his dream is to follow in the footsteps of his grandfather who fought in the First Sino-Japanese War and invaded China, and the pass has an expiration date of just two days. Perhaps he once had a simple aversion to evil acts and hesitated about what he was doing; I do not think he was completely devoid of humanity. But militarism brainwashed him into ignoring the warnings of humanity. He never confronted the contradiction between his humanity and his actions, falling into what Hannah Arendt called a state of “thoughtlessness”. A photo studio is a very clever narrative entry point. At that particular time, photos could only be published through a photo studio, allowing the protagonists to see the real, bloody reality of Nanjing. What is even more shocking is that the people in the photos are not strangers, but neighbors. People who were alive and well yesterday became the victims in today’s photos — a sight that makes one gasp in horror and fury. Lao Jin says, “We cannot be traitors.” Thus, none of this group are traitors. Lin Yuxiu and the child survive and manage to spread the photos; Lao Jin’s wife and daughter die in a senseless, meaningless way, which is even more infuriating. Lao Jin and A Chang take revenge in their own ways, both physically and mentally. Song Cunyi sacrifices his life to save the others, using the Nanjing city wall to crush the Japanese soldiers. Only the traitors die like dogs. In Devils on Horseback, the Japanese army gives candy to children at the beginning of the film, then kills all the children at the end. Ito Hideo initially grants A Chang the right to survive — even granting the right to live is treated as a favor, and he may even have developed a friendship-like feeling for A Chang. But under the urging of his superiors and his own militarist ideology, he rejects humanity and chooses to kill A Chang to completely sever his humanity. Poor Lao Jin never knows until his death that his wife and daughter have already perished. When Ito Hideo rushes into the photo studio at the end, he still lies: “I consider you my friend.” A Chang, with no ties and no way out, tells the truth: “We are not friends.” The phrase “Sino-Japanese friendship” runs through the entire film. Generally, I am not fond of mainstream anti-Japanese war films — I have lost patience with their nonsensical slapstick scenes of ordinary people fighting off Japanese invaders and forced moral preachings. A good film does not need to shout its emotions and values outright; instead, it lets the audience be drawn into those emotions and interpret the values for themselves. The emotional climax of Dead to Rights uses extensive montage techniques — photos themselves serve as excellent bridges for montage. The footage of daily life of Nanjing citizens that Lao Jin replaces Ito Hideo’s film with alternates continuously with shots of the citizens being killed. The beauty of ordinary life is torn apart before the audience in this way. When the daily life footage is mixed with the massacre footage, Ito Hideo flies into a rage — the torn-apart beauty thus carries out a suicidal counterattack, killing Ito Hideo. Ito Hideo once said, “Photos of the Chinese are unimportant.” Photos of the Chinese kill him, and his own photos kill the Japanese officer. In Schindler’s List, a German officer tries to shoot a Jew; after pulling the trigger several times and finding the gun jammed, he ultimately decides not to kill, and he too is killed like a toy. It is the same kind of retribution: after victory, still in Nanjing, the Japanese officer who once treated human lives as worthless is shot dead in the same place. Again, it is the shutter and the trigger — this time, the photo and the bullet meet successfully. In the ending theme song, old photos of Nanjing are shown against the backdrop of the same location today. Now, the country is peaceful and prosperous; there are no traces of the Japanese invaders, only bustling traffic. It is truly moving. I also wonder: Is this film likely to be released overseas? The film itself is of high quality. Films like Schindler’s List, Saving Private Ryan, and even Top Gun have gained international recognition. Could Dead to Rights achieve the same? After watching the film, I rode my bike home and was caught in a heavy downpour, getting drenched — it had been a long time since I last got caught in the rain. It is raining in Shanghai; it must be raining in Nanjing too.

items.title: 在新国立做的梦
items.content: 在新国立做的梦 6/28晚上，我抵达新加坡国立大学，开始近一个月的暑期项目。现在我坐在uTown，不知道应该做什么。项目在今天下午完成了最后的展示，只要明天轮流坐在摊位前介绍就行了。展示之后，我不知道去哪里，想了想，还是来了uTown，一方面自己不习惯一直待在寝室里；另一方面其实是想吃潮州猪脚锅，吃一些猪肉。 我仍旧坐在Education Resources Center的那个靠近且面对大草坪的位置，但是今天却不知道该做些什么。天气还是很好，很多毕业生穿着学士服在拍毕业照，草地上几只小狗在玩闹，我旁边的一只哈士奇被大爷牵着也在朝那里看——这只哈士奇每天都来。我非常喜欢这里的云，这里的云是立体的，饱满的，竟让我感觉和西藏的云有点像，甚至同样都很低。云飘得很快，天渐渐暗下来，云变成橙色和黄色的了。我去Fine Food吃我心心念念的猪脚锅了。 我突然间意识到，这可能是我最后一次来uTown了，也可能是最后一次在uTown看夕阳了。我不知所措，是因为已经意识到这段旅程即将结束，我无法暂停时间，因而只想郑重地点上一个句点——这也让我猛然感到，应该写点东西了。 这是7年前的照片了 新加坡，我第一次来这里是7年之前。那个时候疫情尚未来临，父母还未离婚，经济仍然向好。那段旅程让我不敢忘记，因此我开始写日记，从2018年8月1日，也就是第一天从上海出发抵达新加坡的那一天开始。当时正好赶上了新加坡国庆，看到各种奇怪的飞机飞来飞去，回去的时候在樟宜机场一开始不愿四处逛，临走前又发现来不及去看看仙人掌馆。鸭子船、花穹、云雾岭、夜间动物园……我现在还能记起的似乎也只有这些毫无意义但是充满情感的碎片了——日记就是让我更加放心地遗忘吧。 这次出发前，还在做歌手大赛的那段时间，我就经常梦见自己来到新国立——梦中的新国立有一个类似上中的校门，门口就是地铁站和酒吧——我很向往，但是我不敢抱太高的期望，我担心仍是和一群没什么想法的理工男打交道。 新加坡的气候很好，几乎只有上午下过雨——那时候我还在睡觉，下午也没那么热，晚上开空调会冷——难怪这里有很多挂着大吊扇的开放空间。我十分羡慕新加坡的一点在于新加坡是能够在大楼里面种树的——花园城市名副其实。这里实际上碰到华人面孔都可以说中文——即使用蹩脚的Chinglish问，回答也很有可能是中文。新加坡真的很宜居，很想以后时不时来这里旅居。 在这里也趁空闲时间看了一些电影，包括飞机上看的《天堂电影院》、周末看的《卧虎藏龙》、《勇敢的心》、《低俗小说》、回家候机时看的《国产凌凌漆》，还看完了《混沌武士》。回想起来《混沌武士》中的三人和nus项目的小组很像——莫名甚至是非常虚的原因聚在一起，在晴朗的日子走了许多路，在皆大欢喜的结局后各自成长分别。闲时间做的最重要的事把《地频线》的决赛录像的录音提取了出来，做成了专辑自己听。于我，新加坡也有了《地频线》的影子。 我们的课程最终是需要分成小组来做project的模式。我们组基本上是大佬带飞的状态。最开始的时候，我称他们为组员，但是到了最后，我觉得可以称为朋友了——比我预想的好很多，他们目之所及不止眼前的电脑，而是有着对于世界的个人理解。我们一起做project，一起吃饭，一起去市区，一起看电影，一起庆祝一位的生日，甚至一起做了一件疯狂的事——新加坡骑行一圈60公里——骑到东海岸的路不太好骑，常常被红灯阻挠，但是一到东海岸就变得非常顺畅舒适——海边的音乐、椰子树的剪影、海滩黄昏与混杂着咸味和烧烤味的海风让我想起我小时候去普吉岛，也是热带的海滩的日落，海边的果树挂满了青色的芒果。樟宜机场来来往往的飞机从我们头顶飞过，时不时飞过一些为了国庆训练的军机。与其中一位有摩擦，但同样也碰到了只去相投的朋友。感觉在这里我彻底改去了对于电院全是没有想法的nerd的固有印象——其实还是有很多人闪烁着思想的光芒，他们不仅着眼于眼前的技术，也看见技术背后的目的。他们的技术观和世界观、人生观相互支撑，也已经到达相当深入的鲜有人涉足的地方了。其间，我意识到一个有趣的现象：其实有几位我甚至会把他们投射到一些故人上去——气质很像，样貌很像，但是又确确实实不是同一个人。 当然，我也故地重游。我到新加坡的第二天就去了滨海湾。一切如故，但人变了，世界也变了。让我想起《星际牛仔》里Faye见到夕阳下的鱼尾狮，向着家的方向跑去，但是只见断壁颓垣和那一首《Call me Call me》。云雾林和花穹也还是和原来差不多。云雾岭最近好像在和侏罗纪公园合作，可能是为最近的电影做宣发吧。我小时候在花穹的照片作为个人照，在很多地方使用过——荣誉册、精选PPT，我在同样的位置又拍了一张，但是现在那里全都是玫瑰而不是以前的黄橙色的花儿。曾经的我淹没在花丛中，但是现在花丛却是在脚边。到圣淘沙的时候正好夕阳西下，为了看夕阳，并没有去小时去过的亚洲最南端——不知道现在那里是不是还是那些栈道。我往西走，踩着柔软的沙子，看着紫红色的天水交接之处和停泊在岸边的货轮。 算是认真、郑重的画了个句号吧。天色已经完全暗下来，uTown优雅的灯光亮起来了。不知以后是否还有缘再来NUS，至于新加坡，想必以后常会再来吧？
items.content_en: A Dream at NUS On the evening of June 28th, I arrived at the National University of Singapore to start a nearly one-month summer program. Right now, I’m sitting in uTown, unsure what to do. The final presentation for the program was completed this afternoon; all that’s left is to take turns manning the booth to introduce our work tomorrow. After the presentation, I didn’t know where to go, so I decided to come to uTown. On one hand, I’m not used to staying in my dormitory all the time; on the other hand, I really wanted to eat Teochew pork knuckle hotpot and have some pork. I’m still sitting in the spot near and facing the lawn at the Education Resources Center, but today I have no idea what to do. The weather is still lovely: many graduates are wearing their graduation gowns to take photos, a few puppies are playing on the grass, and a Husky next to me, led by an old man, is also looking over there—this Husky comes here every day. I love the clouds here; they are three-dimensional and plump, making me feel they’re a bit like the clouds in Tibet, and they’re even low-lying too. The clouds drift quickly, and as it gets darker, they turn orange and yellow. I went to Fine Food to eat the pork knuckle hotpot I’d been craving. I suddenly realized that this might be my last time visiting uTown, and possibly my last time watching the sunset here. I’m at a loss because I’ve realized this journey is coming to an end. I can’t pause time, so I just want to draw a solemn full stop—this also made me suddenly feel that I should write something down. This photo was taken 7 years ago. It’s been 7 years since I first came to Singapore. Back then, the pandemic hadn’t hit yet, my parents hadn’t divorced, and the economy was still doing well. I dare not forget that journey, so I started keeping a diary starting from August 1, 2018, the day I arrived in Singapore from Shanghai. I happened to catch Singapore’s National Day then; I saw all sorts of strange planes flying around. When I left, I didn’t want to wander around Changi Airport at first, but before departing I realized I didn’t have time to visit the Cactus House. Duck boats, Flower Dome, Cloud Forest, Night Safari… the only things I can still remember seem to be these meaningless but emotionally charged fragments—diaries let me forget more easily. Before I set off, during the time I was participating in a singing competition, I often dreamed of coming to NUS—in my dream, NUS had a school gate similar to that of Shanghai High School, with a subway station and bars right at the entrance. I yearned for it, but I didn’t dare to set my hopes too high; I worried I’d still be dealing with a bunch of clueless engineering students. Singapore has great weather; it only rained in the morning—when I was still sleeping—and it wasn’t that hot in the afternoon. It gets cold when the air conditioning is on at night—no wonder there are so many open spaces with large ceiling fans here. One thing I envy about Singapore is that trees can be planted inside buildings—the title of “Garden City” is well-deserved. In fact, you can speak Chinese with anyone of Chinese descent here; even if you ask in broken Chinglish, the reply is likely to be in Chinese. Singapore is really livable; I’d love to come here for a staycation from time to time in the future. I also watched a few movies in my spare time here, including Cinema Paradiso on the plane, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, Braveheart, Pulp Fiction on the weekend, Shaolin Soccer while waiting to board my flight home, and I finished watching Samurai Champloo. Looking back, the trio in Samurai Champloo is very similar to my group in the NUS program—they came together for inexplicable, almost trivial reasons, walked a lot on sunny days, and grew and parted ways after a happy ending. The most important thing I did in my spare time was extract the audio from the finals recording of DiPinXian and make an album for myself to listen to. For me, Singapore now also has a trace of DiPinXian. Our course ultimately required us to work on projects in groups. My group was basically led by top performers. At first, I called them group members, but by the end, I felt we could call each other friends—it turned out much better than I expected. Their vision wasn’t limited to the computer in front of them; they had their own understanding of the world. We worked on projects together, ate together, went to the city together, watched movies together, celebrated a teammate’s birthday together, and even did a crazy thing together—riding 60 kilometers around Singapore. The road to East Coast wasn’t easy to ride on; we were often held up by red lights, but once we reached East Coast, it became very smooth and comfortable. The music by the sea, the silhouettes of coconut trees, the beach sunset, and the sea breeze mixed with the smell of salt and barbecue reminded me of my childhood trips to Phuket—those tropical beach sunsets with green mangoes hanging on the seaside trees. Planes coming and going at Changi Airport flew over our heads, and from time to time, military planes training for National Day flew by. I had a few conflicts with one person, but I also met like-minded friends. I feel I’ve completely changed my preconceived notion that all students from the electrical engineering department are clueless nerds—in fact, there are many people whose minds shine brightly; they don’t just focus on current technologies but also see the purposes behind them. Their views on technology, the world, and life support each other, and they’ve reached rather profound realms that few others explore. During this time, I noticed an interesting phenomenon: there are a few people I even project former acquaintances onto—they have similar temperaments and appearances, but they’re definitely not the same people. Of course, I also revisited old places. I went to Marina Bay the day after I arrived in Singapore. Everything was the same, but the people and the world had changed. It reminded me of Faye in Cowboy Bebop seeing the Merlion under the sunset and running towards home, only to find ruins and the song Call Me Call Me. The Cloud Forest and Flower Dome are still pretty much the same as before. The Cloud Forest seems to be collaborating with Jurassic Park recently, probably for a movie promotion. A photo of me in the Flower Dome from my childhood was used as a profile picture in many places—my honor book, selected PPTs. I took another photo in the same spot, but now it’s full of roses instead of the previous yellow-orange flowers. I used to be buried among the flowers, but now the flowers are at my feet. When I went to Sentosa, the sunset was setting; to watch the sunset, I didn’t go to the southernmost point of Asia that I visited as a child—I wonder if those boardwalks are still there now. I walked west, stepping on the soft sand, watching the junction of purple-red sky and water and the cargo ships docked at the shore. I guess I’ve drawn a serious, solemn full stop. It’s completely dark now, and the elegant lights of uTown have turned on. I don’t know if I’ll have the chance to come to NUS again in the future, but I’m sure I’ll come to Singapore often in the future?

在Decode阶段是为所有可能做好准备。读取A，B是为了准备对A，B地址的数据进行操作；计算Branch Destination并存入ALUout是为可能的branch指令做准备。Decode阶段还会准备好Execute阶段对应的控制信号。 Execute阶段： R：计算正确的计算结果 LW/SW：正确的地址覆盖掉ALUout（而不是之前算出来的Branch Destination) R-type</b><br/>RegDst=1<br/>RegWrite=1<br/>MemtoReg=0<br/>PCWriteCond=0] WriteR --> End ExecBeq --> End Jump --> End End-->Start CPI: Cycle per Instruction 5 Pipelining 5.1 Introduction to Pipelining Multiple instructions are being executed simultaneously 5.2 How Pipelining is Implemented 在Single-cycle processor的基础上修改，分为5个阶段：IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB 在每两个阶段中间，加入超大Register，存储数据和ID阶段产生的Control Signal Branch是在MEM阶段解决的 5.3 Pipeline hazards Structure hazard：不同指令在统一时间周期内需要访问同一个硬件资源 解决方法： 给多个端口访问内存 Instruction Memory和Data Memory分离 Data hazard：前一个指令还没完成对于Data的修改，后一个指令就已经读取了数据，ID阶段就需要检查 解决方法： Code Scheduling：不改变执行结果的情况下，让两条Data hazards的指令隔得远一点 Forwarding/Bypassing：通过硬件，不待数据存回内存，就直接给到下一条指令，但是即便如此，lw后一个需要读寄存器的指令依旧会有Data hazard Stalling：给一条空指令（Bubble） Control hazard：Branch影响了Instruction流 解决方法： 把branch提前到ID之后，减少Bubble从2个变为1个 延迟分支和延迟槽：再增加一个无论都会执行的分支，包含两个延迟槽，填充原来两个bubble的位置 分支预测：预测（猜）下一个进入哪一个分支 静态：总是跳转/不跳转 动态： 1位预测器：根据上一次的结果 2位预测器：00，01，10，11，跳转加1，不跳转减1，只有到00和11的时候，才会改变跳不跳转的状态 全局/局部历史预测 prediction correct就继续运行，错误则原来的预测直接flush掉，称为bubble，立即执行正确的 5.4 Exceptions Also-called Interrupt/Fault situations where the normal execution order of instruction is changed, CPU may abort instructions in the pipeline The most difficult exceptions have 2 properties: occur within instructions restartable to save pipeline state: Force a trap instruction into the pipeline on the next IF turn off all writes for all the instructions in the pipeline After the exception-handling routine in the OS receives control, it immediately saves the PC of the faulting instruction two kinds of exceptions precise violation ID Undefined or illegal opcode EX Arithmetic exception MEM Page fault on data fetch; misaligned memory access; memory protection violation WB None 5.5 Handling Multicycle Operations Principle of Locality: Programs tend to reuse data and instructions near those they have used recently, or those were recently referenced themselves. Temporal locality: Recently referenced items are likely to be referenced in the near future. Spatial locality: Items with nearby addresses tend to be referenced close together in time. 一个block的结构： Block address Blockoffset Tag Index 对于一个Four-Way Set Associative Cache，先通过Index定位到一个包含4个Block的组，再通过tag来找到（或者找不到）正确的block，然后再通过Block Offset找到正确的byte Bits per row = Data Bits (Block Size in bits) +Tag Bits+Valid Bit Cache大小的计算：如果一个32位block是22位tag，8位index，2位block offset，又是一个4-way cache，则： set的数量：2^8 每个set中block的数量：4=2^2 每个block中Byte的数量：2^2 所以总大小：28$\times$22$\times$22B=212B=4KB 如果出现Miss的情况，需要替换掉一个block，LRU/FIFO/Random Write strategy： write through：每次都写进cache和memory write back：每次写进cache，只有在替换block的时候写进memory Handling Cache Hits Read hits: Just read it ! items.content_en: 5.5 多周期操作的处理 深度流水线架构下，需要特殊机制处理无法在一个时钟周期内完成的操作。 6 指令级并行 6.1 概念与挑战 目标是最小化CPI（每条指令的平均时钟周期数）。指令间存在三种依赖关系： 数据依赖：一条指令的结果被另一条指令使用 真依赖：前序指令的结果供后续指令读取 反依赖：后续指令会写入前序指令读取的寄存器 输出依赖：多条指令写入同一个寄存器 名称依赖：两条指令使用相同的寄存器或内存位置，但无实际数据关联，可通过寄存器重命名消除 控制依赖：指令的执行结果取决于控制流（如分支指令）的判断结果 数据冒险类型： 写后读（RAW）：后续指令读取前序指令写入的数据 写后写（WAW）：后续指令覆盖前序指令写入的数据 读后写（WAR）：后续指令覆盖前序指令读取的数据 6.2 基础编译器技术 流水线停顿：插入空操作指令填补流水线空隙 流水线调度：调整指令顺序避免冒险 循环展开：减少跳转开销，例如将一次循环的内容拆分为4次执行，需提前计算余数 6.3 利用高级分支预测降低分支代价 控制推测机制：若推测错误，需启动恢复机制，丢弃错误路径上的指令。 分支预测分为动态预测和静态预测，相关内容可参考5.3节的控制冒险部分。 6.4 通过动态调度克服数据冒险 指令译码阶段拆分为两部分： 检测是否存在结构冒险 等待数据冒险解除后再继续执行 为进一步提升效率，可采用按序发射、乱序执行策略：先按顺序将指令送入发射队列，再根据数据就绪情况乱序执行，从而减少数据冒险。实现步骤为： 列出所有WAR和WAW冒险 动态调度 优点：编译器无需了解微架构细节，可处理未知的依赖关系 缺点：硬件更复杂，异常处理逻辑也更繁琐 7 存储层次设计 7.1 缓存组织 flowchart TD Regfile---ITLB Regfile---DTLB ITLB---InstrCache DTLB---DataCache InstrCache---SRAM["二级缓存（SRAM）"] DataCache---SRAM SRAM---DRAM["主存（DRAM）"] DRAM---Disk["辅助存储（磁盘）"] 局部性原理：程序倾向于复用近期使用过的数据或指令，或访问地址相邻的数据。 时间局部性：近期被访问的项未来很可能再次被访问 空间局部性：地址相邻的项往往会在相近时间被访问 块的结构： 块地址 块偏移 标签 索引 以四路组相联缓存为例：先通过索引定位到包含4个块的组，再通过标签匹配正确的块，最后通过块偏移定位到具体的字节。 每行包含的位数 = 数据位（块大小对应的位数）+ 标签位 + 有效位。 若32位块的大小对应22位标签、8位索引、2位块偏移，且为四路缓存，则： 组的数量：2^8 每组中的块数量：4=2^2 每个块包含的字节数：2^2 总大小为：2^8 × 2^2 × 2^2 B = 2^12 B = 4KB。 当发生缓存缺失时，需替换掉一个块，常用替换策略有LRU、FIFO、随机替换。 写策略： 写穿透：每次写操作同时更新缓存和主存 写回：仅更新缓存，只有在该块被替换时才写回主存 缓存命中时的处理： 读命中：直接读取即可 写命中： 要求缓存和主存数据一致：采用写穿透方式，速度较慢，可使用写缓冲区，或当写缓冲区满时暂停执行 允许缓存和主存数据不一致：采用写回方式，需通过脏位标识该块是否需要写回主存，写回时可借助写缓冲区 缓存缺失时的处理： 读缺失：块大小越大，缺失代价越高；读取一个字时需从主存载入整个块。可采用以下优化： 收到块中的字后，无需等待整个块加载完成就开始执行 优先传输所需的字，再传输块的剩余部分 非阻塞式缓存：处理器可在处理先前缺失请求的同时，继续从缓存获取其他数据 写缺失：先将块载入缓存，再执行写入操作 CPU时间计算公式： CPU时间 = (CPU执行时钟周期 + 内存停顿时钟周期) × 时钟周期时间 可见缓存行为对CPU时间影响极大。 7.2 虚拟内存 虚拟页号 + 页偏移 → 物理页号 + 页偏移。由于需要通过页表在物理页中查找与请求的虚拟页号匹配的页，这一过程耗时较长，因此引入TLB解决该问题（TLB仅用于查找数据地址，不负责读取数据，数据读取相关内容见7.1节）。 flowchart TD VPN[虚拟页号]-->|TLB命中|TLB[TLB] VPN-->|TLB未命中|PTR["页表<br>（存储在物理内存中）"] TLB-->Data["缓存、内存或存储中的数据"] PTR-->Data VPN-->|TLB未命中且发生缺页|Data TLB和页表查找到的地址对应的数据可能存储在缓存、内存或存储中。 TLB 页表 缓存 是否可能？适用场景是什么？ 命中 命中 命中 是——正是我们想要的结果！ 命中 命中 未命中 是——TLB命中时无需查询页表 未命中 命中 命中 是——TLB未命中，但能从页表中得到物理地址 未命中 命中 未命中 是——TLB未命中，物理地址在页表中，但数据不在缓存中 未命中 未命中 未命中 是——发生缺页中断 命中 未命中 未命中/命中 不可能——若页面不在内存中，无法进行TLB转换 未命中 未命中 命中 不可能——若页面不在内存中，数据不允许存入缓存 7.3 六种基础缓存优化 平均内存访问时间 = 命中时间 + 缺失率 × 缺失代价 降低缺失率：增大块大小、扩大缓存容量、提高相联度 降低缺失代价：采用多级缓存，优先处理读请求而非写请求 缩短缓存命中时间：索引缓存时避免地址转换过程 缺失的三类原因： 强制性缺失：首次访问某个块时，该块不可能已在缓存中 容量缺失：程序执行过程中所需的块无法全部存入缓存 冲突缺失：在组相联或直接映射缓存中，不同块被映射到同一位置导致 六种基础缓存优化效果对比： 优化方法 \ 影响 强制性缺失 容量缺失 冲突缺失 命中时间 功耗 缺失代价 增大块大小 ⬇️ ⬆️ ⬆️ — — ⬆️ 扩大缓存总容量 — ⬇️ — ⬆️ ⬆️ — 提高相联度 — — ⬇️ ⬆️ ⬆️ — 增加缓存层级 — — — — — ⬇️（访问时间） 优先处理读缺失请求而非写请求 — — — — — ⬇️ 索引缓存时避免地址转换 — — — ⬇️ — — 提高相联度：可提供更多数据存储位置，从而减少冲突缺失 优先处理读缺失请求：通常写操作可暂存在写缓冲区中，因此可等待 避免地址转换：让缓存直接使用虚拟地址访问，省去转换步骤，但存在以下问题： 不同运行中的进程的虚拟地址会相互干扰 进程切换时需要清空缓存 不同虚拟地址可能映射到同一物理地址（别名/同义现象），会导致数据写入不同步 因此采用折中方案：VIPT（虚拟索引、物理标签）。要求：一页只能映射到一个缓存组。 例如四路缓存： 利用虚拟地址的低位部分（页内偏移），该部分包含缓存组索引和块偏移，可直接查询对应组，提取其中4个块的标签 通过虚拟页号得到物理页号，从而获得物理地址的标签 对比两个标签判断是否命中，命中则返回结果，未命中则触发缓存缺失，进一步访问主存 限制条件：缓存大小 = 页面大小 × 相联度 虚拟页号 页内偏移 标签（物理页号） 索引 块偏移 缓存大小 = 组数 × 相联度（每组中的块数） × 块大小 = 2^索引位数 × N × 2^字节偏移位数 最小页面大小 = 缓存大小 ÷ 相联度 = 组数 × 块大小 = 2^索引位数 × 2^字节偏移位数 7.4 十种高级缓存性能优化 小巧简单的一级缓存 路径预测 缓存流水线化 非阻塞缓存：允许在前序缺失请求完成前就处理命中请求 多体缓存：支持同时访问 关键字优先、提前重启 关键字优先：优先请求关键字数据供CPU使用 提前重启：按顺序请求数据，拿到关键字后立即提供给CPU，无需等待全部加载完成 合并写缓冲区：若要写入的数据已在写缓冲区中，直接更新缓冲区内容 编译器优化：例如矩阵读取顺序从左右上下调整为上下左右 硬件预取：利用原本闲置的内存带宽 编译器预取：在需要数据前插入预取指令（寄存器/缓存） 7.5 存储技术与优化 性能核心指标：延迟与带宽。 SRAM：主要用于缓存，结构复杂且成本高 DRAM：主要用于主存，结构简单且比SRAM便宜 闪存：属于EEPROM的一种 新趋势：NVM（非易失性存储器） 8 数据级并行 8.1 简介 相关内容可参考1.2节最后的Flynn分类法，包括SISD、MISD、SIMD、MIMD。 SIMD的优势： 可充分利用数据级并行 能效更高 对程序员更友好 8.2 向量架构 基本思路： 将一组数据元素读入“向量寄存器” 对这些寄存器执行运算 将结果分散写回内存 VMIPS架构： 向量寄存器：包含64个元素，每个元素为64位；有16个读端口和8个写端口（每次读写一个元素） 向量功能单元：全流水线设计，可检测数据和控制冒险 向量加载存储单元：全流水线设计，初始延迟后每个时钟周期可传输一个字 标量寄存器：32个通用寄存器，32个浮点寄存器 向量算术运算采用更深度的流水线：由于向量中的元素相互独立，不会产生冒险，因此可简化深度流水线的控制逻辑。 向量操作序列的执行时间由三个因素决定： 操作数向量的长度 结构冒险 数据依赖 通过向量长度寄存器（VLR）控制任何向量操作的长度，包括向量加载和存储。 向量掩码寄存器：用于选择参与运算的位。 大多数向量处理器采用内存库设计，以支持多个独立访问操作。 8.3 SIMD指令集扩展 向量架构成本高且制造难度大，因此采用折中方案：通过SIMD指令在普通架构的机器上实现近似向量机的效果。许多指令会附加“.4D”这类后缀，表示一次可处理4个双精度数据。 8.4 GPU（图形处理器） flowchart TD VG[顶点生成]-->VP[顶点处理] VP-->PG[图元生成] PG-->PP[图元处理] PP-->FG[片段生成] FG-->FP[片段处理] FP-->PO[像素操作] CUDA（统一计算设备架构）具备高度并行特性。 网格 ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ 块0 块1 ... │ ← 一个网格中包含多个块 │ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ 线程x │ │ 线程x │ │ ← 每个块中包含多个线程 │ │ 线程y │ │ 线程y │ │ │ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ │ └─────────────────────────────┘ 一个函数对应一个内核，即一个网格，网格下划分多个块，块中包含多个线程。块之间不共享数据，线程之间可共享数据。块是调度单位，线程是运算单位，一般一个块中最多包含1024个线程。 例如：若一个函数需要对8192位数据进行取反操作，该函数即为一个内核，对应一个网格，可划分为8个块，每个流式多处理器（SM）负责运行一个块，每个SM内部可同时运行1024个线程。 存储类型 读写权限 作用范围 存储位置 速度 寄存器 读写 每个线程 GPU寄存器 🚀 最快 局部内存 读写 每个线程 全局内存 🐢 较慢<br>（存储在全局内存中） 共享内存 读写 每个块 片上（SM内部） ⚡ 较快``（低延迟，需手动管理） 全局内存 读写 整个网格 GPU DRAM片外 🐌 最慢``（延迟高） 常量内存 只读 整个网格 GPU DRAM片外``（带读缓存） ⚡ 适合广播``（有缓存） 纹理内存 只读 整个网格 GPU DRAM片外``（带纹理缓存） ⚡ 针对空间访问优化`` 此处标注的“只读”是针对内核而言，可通过CPU经CUDA API写入。 每个内核支持1维、2维或3维，可自由选择启用的维度。 warp：由SM调度warp，一个warp可同时执行32个线程。warp内的线程并行执行，warp之间的调度类似轮询机制。

u_{X,G}=\dfrac1{\left |Gight |}\sum\limits_{g\in G}\left| Fix\left( gight )ight |,\ for\ g\in G\ let\ Fix(g)={x\in X:g*x=x}$ 本质上：两种数法 固定颜色的排列，看看它的permutation有几种 固定operator，看看不变的颜色（stablizer）有几种 2.6 估值 调和级数估值：$\dfrac12\lfloor\log_2nfloor<\sum\limits_{i=1}^n\dfrac1i=H_n<\log_2n+1,\ 	herefore H_n=\Theta(\ln n)$ 阶乘估值（大小为$n$的集合$X$，其上的置换一共有$n!$个） 极值点估值：$2^n<\left(\dfrac n2ight)^\dfrac n2<\prod\limits_{i=n/2}^n\dfrac n2=n!<n^n$ 高斯估值（均值不等式）:$n^{ rac n2}=\prod\limits_{i=1}^n\sqrt n\leq\prod\limits_{i=1}^n\sqrt{i(n+1-i)}=\left (\sqrt{\prod\limits_{i=1}^n i(n+1-i)}=\sqrt{n!\cdot n!}=n!ight )\leq\prod\limits_{i=1}n\dfrac{n+1}2=\left(\dfrac{n+1}2ight)n$ 进一步优化，使用$1+x≤e^x$与归纳，得到$e\left(\dfrac neight)^n\leq n\leq en\left(\dfrac neight)^n$ 事实上，Stirling公式：$\lim\limits_{n	o \infty}\dfrac{\sqrt{2\pi n}( rac ne)^n}{n!}=1$ 二项式系数估值：$\left (\dfrac nkight)^k\leq inom nk\leq\sum\limits_{i=0}^k inom ni\leq(\dfrac{en}k)^k$，右边的证明利用二项式定理+赋值$x=\dfrac kn$ 3 Graph theory 图论 3.1 Basic notions and hand shaking lemma 图的最小度$\delta(G)$，最大度$\Delta G$ 子图：边集和点集都是子集 导出子图（induced subgraph）：子图中的点集在原图中的边，都是子图的边 生成子图 （spanning subgraph）：子图和原图的点集相等 特殊图 路径图（Path Pn)：$V={0,1,\cdots,n}$ $E={(i-1,i):i=1,2,\cdots,n}$ 2. 环（Circle Cn）：$V={0,1,\cdots,n}$ $E={(i,i+1):i=1,2,\cdots,n-1}\cup{(1,n)}$ 3. 二分图（Bipartite graph Bn,m）：$V={u_1,\cdots,u_n}\cup{v_1,\cdots,v_m}$ $E\subseteq{(u_i,v_j):i=1,2,\cdots,n;\ j=1,2,\cdots,m}$ 其中$\subseteq$取等号时，为完全二分图（Complete Bipartite graph Kn,m） 4. 完全图：（Complete graph Kn） 5. r-正则图（r-regular graph）：所有顶点度数都是常值r的图 6. 简单图（Simple Graph）：没有自环（Loop）、重边（Multiedge） 7. $ egin{cases}路径(Path)：不允许环，各顶点和边各出现一次\游走(Walk)：允许环，顶点和边可以重复\end{cases}$ 8. 连通图：任两点存在路径 9. 极大连通子图：子图；连通图；极大 10. 树；无环连通图 握手定理：$\sum\limits_{v\in V}deg_G(v)=2\left | Eight|$奇点有偶数个 3.2 Graph isomorphism and graph score 有$n$个顶点且不同构的图有$x$个，则$\dfrac{2^ inom n2}{n!}\leq x\leq2^ inom n2$，所以$x=2{\Theta( rac{n2}2)}$ Graph score: the degree sequence of G Isomorphic graphs $\Rightarrow$ The same scores The same scores $
Rightarrow$ Isomorphic graphs Score Theroem：去掉度数最高的点，前最高点数的点度数减一，可以画图性不变 $D=(d_1,d_2,\cdots,d_n)，d_1\leq d_2\leq\cdots\leq d_n$ $d'= egin{cases}d_i&i<n-d_n\d_i-1&i\geq n-d_n\end{cases}$ $D与D'可画图性一致$ 3.3 Applications of handshake lemma: Parity argument Sperner's Lemma：对任意𝑛维单形体(𝑛-simplex)进行分割并用𝑛 + 1种颜色去着色，则任何合适的单形体分割着色方案下，都必有一个包含所有不同颜色的单元。 对于3-正则图，包含图上任意边$e$的哈密顿回路必有偶数条 3.5 Isomorphism of trees 叶子：度数为1的顶点 树生长定义：对于图$G$的叶子节点$v$，图$G$是树$\Leftrightarrow$图$G-v$是树 树的等价刻画： 图$G$是树。 路径唯一：对任意两点 $ u, v \in V$，存在从$u$到$v$的唯一路径。 最小连通图：$G$是连通图，且去掉任意一条边后都成为非连通图。 最大无环图：$G$不含环，但增加任何一条边所得到的图$G + e $（其中$e \in  inom{V}{2} \setminus E $）中含有一个环。 Euler 方程：$ G $ 是连通图，且 $ |V| = |E| + 1 $。 证明顶点数为$n$的不同构树有$n^{n-2}$ Score硬算，化简得到 骨骼标本与V上的函数图一一对应，每棵树对应n2个骨骼标本$\dfrac {nn}{n2}=n^{n-2}$ Prüfer The number of spanning trees 树同构 有根树同构$\cong'$，编码（非根叶节点01，每个个节点的编码都是0+所有子树编码+1）后字典序排序即可 无根树同构$\cong$ 一些概念 两点距离：最短路径长度$dis_G(u,v)$ 一点偏心率：该点与其他点最大距离$ex_G(v)$ 中心：偏心率最小的顶点集合$C(G)$，对于树而言，该集合大小为1或者2 解法 找到中心 中心集合大小为1，其为根，转化为有根树 中心集合大小为2，去掉中心两点的连线，转化为两棵有根树 4 概率论 The probabilistic method 4.1 Probability: a quick review $P(E|F)=\dfrac{P(E\cap F)}{P(F)}$，若独立，则$P(E|F)=P(E)$ 全概率公式 Law of total probability: k=0,1,2,...,n,\quad 0<p<1 $ $np$ $np(1−p)$ 泊松分布$P(\lambda)$ $P(X=k)= rac{\lambda {k}}{k!}e{-λ},\quad \quad k=0,1,2,...,\quad λ>0$ $\lambda$ $\lambda$ 几何分布$G(p)$ $P(X=k)=p(1-p)^{k-1}, k=1, 2, \cdots, 0<p<1$ $ rac{1}{p}$ $ rac{1-p}{p^{2}}$ 指数分布$E(\lambda)$ $f(x)=\left { egin{matrix} \lambda e^{-\lambda x}, &x>0\ 0, \end{matrix} ight.$其他 $ rac{1}{\lambda}$ $ rac{1}{\lambda^{2}}$ 正态分布$N(\mu, \sigma^{2})$ $f(x, y)= rac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma}e{- rac{(x-\mu){2}}{2\sigma^{2}}}, -\infty <x<+\infty, -\infty <\mu <+\infty, \sigma >0$ $\mu$ $\sigma^{2}$ 概率的估算 Markov's Inequality: $X$ is a random variable that assumes only non-negtive values, $P(X\geq a)\leq\dfrac{E[X]}a$ Chebyshev's Inequality: $P(\left|X-E[X]ight|\geq a)\leq\dfrac{Var[X]}{a^2}$ 变形：$P(X\geq a)=P_{min}(e^{tX}\geq e^{ta})\leq \min\limits_{t>0}\dfrac{E(e{tX})}{e{t\cdot a}}$ Union bound：并集不等式 4.2 Probabilistic method Ramsey number if $ inom nk2^{- inom nk+1}<1$, then it is possible to color the edges of $K_n$ with two colors so that it has no single-colored $K_k$ subgraphs Any system consisting of fewer than $2^{k-1}$ sets of size k admits a 2-coloring Theorem. Let $G$ be a graph with an even number, $2n$, of vertices and with $m > 0$ edges. items.title: 影评：《姊妹之歌》
items.content: #SIFF2025 长宁百丽宫影城 这部电影给我的感觉是：有真实的复杂性：其对于桎梏的描述有两重性。 电影中对于桎梏的展示是非常具有层次性：由宏观到微观，由背景到具体的事情： 最开始展现出来的Nasreen的家庭，无疑是美满的——与丈夫、孩子非常幸福地生活。伊朗这个国家看上去和世俗国家也别无二异：唱歌的母亲，看球的父子，拿着xbox手柄的儿子，iPhone，google。 第一层桎梏是国家、社会带来的，在电影开头就提到：女性不能在公开场合唱歌。警车在旁边时感受到的不是安全，而是警觉：停止唱歌，戴上头纱，小心摄像机。纹身师说：“我给xxx（那个女歌手，忘记名字了）纹过身，她戴着头巾唱歌，谷歌上都查不到她的脸，女性在国内唱歌有限制。”摄影师应：“女性在国内有很多限制。”纹身师问：“纹这个真的值得这么痛嘛？”Nasreen在手指上纹上了women。 第二层桎梏是丈夫：开始时的幸福，后面才知道这只不过是一个不具体的表象，一旦到具体的生活，这就是一段不幸福的婚姻。太经典了：晚归的丈夫、不爱的丈夫、自私的丈夫。甚至其实两人一开始在一起都是因为家庭内部的催婚压力，甚至抚养小孩对于丈夫的付出小于儿子的付出。 第三层桎梏是原生家庭：母亲一直支持Nasreen，Nasreen也一直认为父亲在的话会支持自己唱歌，会保护自己免于丈夫的冷暴力。但是母亲还是传统的，父亲的支持最终还是父权赋予的权利，而不是个人独立带来的力量，当初Nasreen结婚都是半处于家庭给到的压力。 但是这部电影的对于整个事件的刻画是具体的，不是一昧地否定。母亲最终也还是尊重女儿离婚的意愿，并且为了帮女儿承担压力而陪同女儿一起去离婚，原生家庭是桎梏，但也是支撑。和前夫也算是离婚离得干净，获得抚养权、抚养费，Nasreen在法律的支持下也获得了应有的保障。 离婚之后Nasreen走出家门，不为家庭所累（当然也是因为母亲的支持和子女的成长），找到了一份支持自己的职业（伊朗的女性生存状况，至少没有差到一个女人养不活自己，完全依附于一个男人）。其实这在某种程度上，回答了“娜拉出走之后，然后呢”的问题。 影片的结尾还是秉有对未来的希望：伊朗知名女歌手牵头，希望改变伊朗对于女性的偏见与歧视。Nasreen的母亲生日，许下了伊朗和平的宏大愿望。儿子Hamid说，乌龟会把头抬出水面呼吸——下一代会好吗？Hamid支持母亲唱歌，未来的伊朗，会支持女性平等的地位吗？
items.content_en: SIFF2025 Changning Palace Cinema My impression of this film is that it presents genuine complexity: its portrayal of constraints has a dual nature. The film depicts constraints in a highly layered way, moving from the macro to the micro, from the background to specific events: At first glance, Nasreen's family appears idyllic—she lives happily with her husband and children. Iran itself seems no different from secular countries: a mother who sings, a father and son watching a match, a son holding an Xbox controller, iPhones, Google. The first layer of constraints comes from the state and society. As mentioned at the beginning of the film, women are not allowed to sing in public. When a police car is nearby, what they feel is not safety but vigilance: stop singing, put on a hijab, watch out for cameras. The tattoo artist says, "I tattooed xxx (that singer, I forgot her name). She sings while wearing a headscarf, and you can’t even find her face on Google; there are restrictions on women singing in the country." The photographer adds, "Women face many restrictions in the country.” The tattoo artist asks, “Is getting this tattoo really worth so much pain?” Nasreen tattoos the word "women" on her finger. The second layer of constraints comes from her husband. The initial happiness turns out to be a superficial facade; once daily life begins, it becomes an unhappy marriage. It’s a classic scenario: a husband who comes home late, doesn’t love her, and is selfish. In fact, they got together initially due to family pressure to marry, and the husband contributes less to raising their child than the son does. The third layer of constraints comes from her family of origin. Nasreen’s mother always supported her, and Nasreen always believed her father would support her singing and protect her from her husband’s emotional abuse. However, her mother remains traditional; her father’s support ultimately stems from patriarchal privilege rather than personal independence. Nasreen’s marriage was also partly driven by family pressure. Yet the film portrays the entire situation in a concrete way, without simply negating everything. In the end, her mother respects her daughter’s decision to divorce and even accompanies her to the divorce proceedings to help bear the burden. The family of origin is both a constraint and a source of support. Nasreen’s divorce is clean: she gains custody and alimony, and with legal backing, she receives the protection she deserves. After the divorce, Nasreen steps out of the home, unburdened by family obligations (thanks to her mother’s support and her children’s growth), and finds a job that supports her (the situation of Iranian women is such that at least they can support themselves and are not completely dependent on a man). In a way, this answers the question, "What happens after Nora leaves home?" The film ends on a note of hope for the future: a well-known Iranian singer takes the lead in trying to change prejudice and discrimination against women in Iran. On Nasreen’s mother’s birthday, she makes a grand wish for peace in Iran. Her son Hamid says, "A turtle will lift its head out of water to breathe”—will the next generation fare better? Hamid supports his mother’s singing. Will future Iran embrace gender equality?

items.content: 2025 WWDC 小谈 说来好笑，正是因为复习量子物理到深夜，我才得以观看2025WWDC的直播。这是我第一次看WWDC的直播，第二次看苹果发布会的直播（上一次是“scary fast”)。对于这次WWDC，我觉得还算是满意吧，虽然没怎么回答我想问的问题，但是至少还算是给了一份答卷。 Apple Intelligence——失望与期望 2024年的苹果发布会，画了一张巨大的大饼——Apple Intelligence。这是苹果近年来唯一的一次食言，起了个大早，赶了个晚集。去年刚发布的时候，这看上去又是“Only Apple can do”，提出了既能保护用户隐私又能帮助用户的人工智能的结构概念，都以为是又一次苹果为一片混沌的新领域证明正确的发展和应用的方向，但结果却是一场惨痛的滑铁卢，甚至让苹果背上“虚假宣传”的骂名。 目前为止，我听到的消息来自林亦LYi，认为他讲得还是较为详细有理。简言之苹果机器学习的高管John Giannandrea面对ChatGPT的横空出世不作为，没有跟上AI发展的浪潮，但又做足了面子工程，画了很多饼，目前机器学习相关团队被重组给了帅气迷人幽默的Craig Federighi（主管软件工程）和Mike Rockwell（Vision Pro总负责）。这两人由于John的不作为积怨已久，且专业能力管理能力均较强，我本以为今年可能就已经会有很大的改观，但是事实上并没有这么快。希望WWDC2026上苹果给出一份满意的答卷！ Apple Intelligence落后了吗？落后了！但是，我认同，现在也没有落后很多。因为其他厂商对于AI功能加入系统的方式仍然是一片混沌，并没有找到一种深刻影响工作效率的方法。而且仍然有许多亟待解决的伦理问题——例如荣耀MagicOS的“一句话点外卖”功能，是基于AI对于屏幕内容的识别，一方面这是对于隐私的侵犯；另一方面误操作的成本谁来负担，这都是目前没有伦理共识。所以，其实在这个时候各个厂商都有点踟蹰不前，因为有点没有前进的空间。但是苹果提出要端侧模型和云端模型并重，提出了一个合理的结构，规避了这个伦理问题，所以其实苹果是由前进空间，只是在科技方面有点落后了。诚然如此，但是苹果其实依然没有为伦理的讨论做出贡献，苹果只是规避了这个问题，纳入旧伦理的体系中去解决这个问题。 我比较感兴趣的Apple intelligence的理念反而是在WatchOS的部分提到的，里面提到一个关键词**“主动性”**，我认为这其实一针见血地指出了AI应用发展的一个重要方向。希望不要沦落到概念先行，从未落地的田地。 Liquid Glass——松了一口气 UI更新是本次发布会又一次比较重要的内容。本来听过太多rumor，见过太多丑丑的渲染图，祈祷过无数次不会改不要乱改，不要为了改而改。最终给出的答卷还算满意。最终听到的消息是要统一为Vision Pro的视觉语言，之后就被曲解为圆形图标——我为此担心了很久，直至被这个来自谐门东西的视频说服。简言之，圆形图标只有Vision Pro和Apple Watch的“无限平面”的设计语言才会出现，且为蜂窝状排列，不仅如此，Vision pro里的iPad兼容app还需要通过图标的方圆来区分。因此不可能改为圆形图标，一切只是以讹传讹。 最终的设计，我认为还是维持了苹果的审美的——甚至加入了透明app图标，这多像是概念版的iOS啊！（但是其实我不喜透明图标，因为丧失了颜色对于视觉的传达。）新的UI最被人诟病的是可读性的问题——透明让底层的内容影响了顶层内容的阅读。这个问题在这个四位up主对谈的视频里讨论过。新UI的实现分为四层——Lense层（基础的材质）、Diffusion层（让透视光线变柔和）、高光层（控制透明度）、 文字与UI。为了改善可读性，苹果官方的文档都指出可以调整Diffusion层与高光层。事实上，在视频播放器界面，暂停按钮（纯SVG图标）和+10s、-10s按钮（混合了文字的图标）已经做了可读性的区别。但是在控制中心，苹果对于可读性的控制就非常差——明明通过调整参数就可以解决。不知道是不是为了小小引起热度，还是纯粹是beta版系统不够完善。我看到的小道消息是，控制中心就是还没有做完。 （感觉对第三方未适配app的支持还不错） 这个UI的另外一个争议是对性能和续航的损耗。WWDC引出新UI的方式都是说“随着算力的提高”，而且这种材质和效果势必会增加性能与续航的压力。我看到的小道消息，说是并没有用到光追，但是也确实非常吃性能和能耗。就我自己而言，我本来想为了体验iPad版的Journal（事实上也并未上线），把我的A15 iPad mini 6升级至了Developer Beta，结果系统卡顿到了一个完全不可用的状态。我现在手持的还是续航尿崩的苹果小火龙——iPhone 15 pro，在极客湾续航排行榜中垫底，已经开始担心续航了。 iPadOS——史诗级提升 iPadOS红绿灯冒出来的那一刻，我就震惊了。 我认为桌面操作系统和移动端操作系统的根本区别有两个 手动杀后台vs自动杀后台 以文件为中心vs以应用为中心 其实这次iPadOS确实在这两个方向发力。 对于前者，iPadOS允许了应用保持在后台，但是它的逻辑其实是折中的：对于桌面操作系统来说，默认不自动杀后台；对于移动操作系统，默认自动杀后台；而对于这次的iPadOS，默认自动杀后台，但是程序可以调取API，申请自己不被杀掉的权限。这这种操作逻辑足够简单，保持了移动端方面管理窗口的优势；又足够精细，保持了桌面端管理进程的优势。期待实际使用的效果。 对于后者，传统来说，桌面操作系统的应用可以对所有的文件都可以方便地获得相关权限，移动操作系统的应用只能获取该应用下文件的相关权限，想要获得全局的权限就相对麻烦。新的iPadOS维持了这一点不变，但是改变了其表现形式——桌面系统的表现也是以文件为中心的，其桌面上是文件；移动操作系统是以应用为中心的，其桌面上是应用。但是新的iPadOS允许将文件固定到Docker栏上，这已经部分地把文件和应用放到同一个等级上了（虽然安卓早已可以）。没有实际体验过，不知道这种程度的对于文件的地位的提升是否足够生产力的发展。 所以，你的下一台电脑，是否还需要是一台电脑吗？ iPadOS更新至此，生产力的瓶颈就不是系统了，而是应用了，之前被系统困太久的厂商可以发力了，做出一些更加像样的iPad端桌面级App了。 但是，随之我们又有了另外一个问题，那Mac呢？ 上文所提的四位up对谈视频中有人提出，Mac和iPad只是占据各自舒适的生态位，我对此不完全赞同。我对于它的最直觉的感受是，iPad采用更加接近Mac的逻辑反而使得Mac的逻辑更容易被大家接受，反而会促进大家对于Mac的接受。而iPad本身承担的是“触屏电脑”的地位——Mac从来不做触控屏，是因为那个角度触控很别扭，但是触控放到iPad形态的桌面端设备，反而就合理起来，不论是硬件形态还是系统上。 可喜可贺，可喜可贺！不知道二手的iPad pro会不会涨价。这下12.9英寸和13英寸的iPad，M系列芯片的Mac，全部都更加合理了。 3D照片——新的护城河？ 之前up主两颗皮蛋制作过系列节目【苹果护城河】，其中就有一期讲的是HDR，深以为然。 我认为，苹果在影像方面的护城河，历来有三： 其一为实况：前些年不受到广泛支持，从各个app对其适配，推动安卓也对其适配，其中经过近10年； 其二为HDR：苹果的HDR管理真的最完善最简单，而安卓与Windows的HDR管理总是相当麻烦。现在印象里安卓已经做得不错了，对安卓不构成护城河了，但是Windows的HDR管理依旧一言难尽，HDR与SDR的区分做得很差（不过近年来不怎么用Windows尤其是高端Windows了，也只是印象，欢迎反驳）； 其三为视频：iPhone的视频能力就是一直都一骑绝尘：尤其是稳定的4k60Hz和防抖性能更是，还有一些电影效果之类的有意思的功能，至今应当仍为护城河（也是印象里，欢迎举反例）。 而今年增加了照片3D化的功能，我认为很有可能是新的护城河。我更新了beta版的iPadOS之后的体验还是相对来说满意的，虽然达不到Vision Pro的效果，虽然只有富有层次感/主体在照片中心/使用广角拍摄的效果较好，但是依然让我很激动，感觉照片真的比以前更加鲜活了。上文所提的四位Up对谈中提出，这不是简单的双眼视察，而是运用了近1，2年兴起的高斯泼溅技术，迅速地将其应用到了新系统，确实让人印象深刻。 一些笑点 伟大的Apple Music支持了歌词翻译和读音！！ 什么聊天工具现在才支持换背景 向飞书学习——多彩文件夹+emoji items.content_en: A Brief Talk on WWDC 2025 Funny enough, it was because I was reviewing quantum physics late at night that I got to watch the 2025 WWDC livestream. This was my first time watching a WWDC livestream and my second time watching an Apple event livestream (the previous one was the “scary fast” event). Overall, I’m fairly satisfied with this WWDC: although many of my questions weren’t answered, Apple at least provided a response. Apple Intelligence — Disappointment and Expectations At Apple’s 2024 event, the company painted a huge picture with Apple Intelligence. This was the only time Apple failed to deliver on a promise in recent years; they got a late start despite early hype. When it was first announced last year, it seemed like another example of “Only Apple can do this”: a concept for AI that would both protect user privacy and assist users. Many thought it would once again prove Apple’s right path for developing and applying technology in a chaotic new field. But in reality, it turned into a disastrous flop, even earning Apple the reputation of “false advertising”. So far, the information I’ve heard comes from Lin Yi LYi, whose analysis is quite detailed and reasonable. In short, John Giannandrea, Apple’s senior executive in machine learning (John Giannandrea), did nothing in response to the emergence of ChatGPT and failed to keep up with the AI development trend. Yet he put on a show of grand promises. Currently, the machine learning-related teams have been reassigned to the charismatic and humorous Craig Federighi (head of software engineering) and Mike Rockwell (in charge of Vision Pro). These two had long harbored resentment over John’s inaction, and both have strong professional and management skills. I thought we might see major improvements this year, but that didn’t happen as quickly as expected. Hopefully Apple will provide a satisfactory answer at WWDC 2026! Is Apple Intelligence behind? Yes, it is! But I also agree that the gap isn’t that large now. Other manufacturers are still struggling to integrate AI features into their systems in a way that significantly boosts work efficiency. There are also many urgent ethical issues to resolve—for example, Honor’s MagicOS “order food with one command” feature relies on AI to recognize screen content. On one hand, this violates user privacy; on the other hand, it’s unclear who will bear the cost of accidental operations, as there’s no current ethical consensus on this. So, all manufacturers are currently hesitant to move forward, as there’s little room for progress. However, Apple proposed giving equal importance to on-device models and cloud models, creating a reasonable framework that avoids these ethical issues. Thus, Apple actually has room to advance, even if it’s a bit behind in terms of technology. That said, Apple still hasn’t contributed to the ethical discussion; it simply avoided the issue by incorporating it into existing ethical frameworks. The Apple Intelligence concept that interests me most was mentioned in the watchOS section, where the keyword “proactivity” was used. I think this precisely points to an important direction for AI application development. Hopefully, it won’t just remain a concept that never materializes. Liquid Glass — A Relief UI updates were another major highlight of this event. I’d heard too many rumors, seen too many ugly renderings, and prayed countless times that Apple wouldn’t make unnecessary changes just for the sake of changing. The final result was satisfactory. The initial news was that the UI would adopt the visual language of Vision Pro, which was misinterpreted as circular icons—I worried about this for a long time until I watched this video by Xiemen Dongxi. In short, circular icons only appear in the “infinite plane” design language of Vision Pro and Apple Watch, and they’re arranged in a honeycomb pattern. Plus, iPad apps compatible with Vision Pro need to be distinguished from regular apps by their icon shape. So, it’s impossible for the UI to switch to circular icons; all those claims were just misinformation. In my opinion, the final design maintains Apple’s aesthetic—it even includes transparent app icons, which looks like a conceptual version of iOS! (Though I personally dislike transparent icons, as they lose the visual impact of color.) The most criticized aspect of the new UI is readability: the transparency causes the underlying content to interfere with reading the top-layer content. This issue was discussed in the video Four Creators’ Discussion. The new UI consists of four layers: the Lense layer (basic material), Diffusion layer (softens transmitted light), Highlight layer (controls transparency), and text/UI elements. To improve readability, Apple’s official documentation notes that you can adjust the Diffusion and Highlight layers. In fact, in the video player interface, the pause button (a pure SVG icon) and the +10s/-10s buttons (icons with text mixed in) already have distinguishable readability. But in the Control Center, Apple’s control over readability is poor—something that could easily be fixed by adjusting parameters. I’m not sure if this is done to generate some buzz or if it’s simply due to the beta version being incomplete. The rumor I heard is that the Control Center isn’t finished yet. (I find the support for third-party apps that aren’t yet optimized to be quite good.) Another controversy surrounding this UI is its impact on performance and battery life. Apple promoted the new UI at WWDC by saying “as computing power improves”, and such materials and effects will inevitably increase the load on performance and battery. The rumor I heard is that Apple didn’t use ray tracing, but the UI still consumes a lot of performance and energy. Personally, I wanted to try the iPad version of Journal (which wasn’t released anyway), so I upgraded my A15-powered iPad mini 6 to the Developer Beta—only to find the system was so laggy it was unusable. I’m currently using an iPhone 15 Pro, a device with notoriously poor battery life that ranks at the bottom of Geekbench’s battery rankings, and I’m already worried about its battery performance. iPadOS — An Epic Upgrade I was shocked when the iPadOS traffic light feature appeared. I think there are two fundamental differences between desktop operating systems and mobile operating systems: Manual background process termination vs. automatic background process termination File-centric vs. app-centric This time, iPadOS indeed focused on both aspects. Regarding the former, iPadOS allows apps to stay in the background, but the logic is a compromise: for desktop operating systems, background processes aren’t terminated by default; for mobile operating systems, they are terminated by default. For this iPadOS, background processes are terminated by default, but apps can call APIs to request permission to stay active. This operation logic is simple enough to retain the advantages of mobile systems in window management, while being precise enough to maintain the advantages of desktop systems in process management. I look forward to seeing how it performs in practice. Regarding the latter, traditionally, apps on desktop operating systems can easily access all files, while apps on mobile operating systems can only access files within their own directory; getting global access is relatively difficult. The new iPadOS keeps this unchanged but alters its presentation: desktop systems are file-centric, with files on the desktop; mobile operating systems are app-centric, with apps on the desktop. But the new iPadOS allows files to be pinned to the Dock, partially elevating files to the same level as apps (though Android has supported this for a while). Without trying it myself, I’m not sure if this level of elevation of files’ status is sufficient to drive productivity growth. So, do you still need a separate computer as your next device? With these iPadOS updates, the bottleneck for productivity is no longer the system—it’s the apps. Manufacturers that were held back by the system for too long can now step up and create more decent desktop-level apps for iPad. But then we have another question: what about the Mac? Someone in the aforementioned Four Creators’ Discussion video argued that the Mac and iPad simply occupy their respective comfortable niches, and I don’t fully agree. My intuitive feeling is that iPad adopting a logic closer to the Mac makes the Mac’s logic easier for people to accept, thus promoting adoption of the Mac. iPad itself serves as a “touchscreen computer”—the Mac doesn’t have a touchscreen because touch interaction is awkward from that angle, but it makes sense for a desktop device in iPad form, both in terms of hardware and software. What a relief! I wonder if the price of used iPad Pros will rise. Now, 12.9-inch and 13-inch iPads, as well as Macs with M-series chips, all make more sense. Spatial Scenes — A New Moat? Creator Two Century Eggs produced a series called 【Apple’s Moats], and one episode covered HDR, which I completely agree with. I think Apple has three traditional moats in imaging: The first is Live Photos: they weren’t widely supported in earlier years, but after various apps adapted to them, Android followed suit—a process that took nearly 10 years. The second is HDR: Apple’s HDR management is truly the most complete and simplest, while HDR management on Android and Windows is always quite troublesome. I recall Android has improved a lot now, so it no longer forms a moat for Apple, but HDR management on Windows remains poor, with a bad distinction between HDR and SDR (though I rarely use Windows, especially high-end Windows versions these days, so this is just my impression; feel free to correct me). The third is video: iPhone’s video capabilities have always been far ahead, especially its stable 4K60Hz recording and image stabilization, along with interesting features like Cinematic mode. These should still form a moat today (again, just my impression; feel free to provide counter-examples). This year, Apple added the Spatial Scenes feature, which I think could become a new moat. My experience with the beta version of iPadOS was relatively satisfying: although it doesn’t match the effect of Vision Pro, and the best results come from photos with clear depth, a centered subject, or taken with a wide-angle lens, I’m still excited—photos feel much more vivid than before. As mentioned in the Four Creators’ Discussion, this isn’t simple binocular vision; Apple applied Gaussian splatting, a technology that emerged in the past 1-2 years, to the new system quickly, which is truly impressive. Some Funny Moments Great! Apple Music now supports lyric translation and pronunciation!! What chat app finally supports custom backgrounds? 第一章 量子物理基础 1.1 光量子、玻尔原子 1.1.1 黑体辐射与普朗克的量子假设 基尔霍夫辐射定律 单色辐出度$M(\lambda,T)=\dfrac{dE_\lambda}{d\lambda}(w/m^3)$：单位时间物体表面单位面积内发射的波长在$\lambda$附近单位波长间隔内的辐射能 总辐出度$M(T)=\int_0^{+\infty}M(\lambda,T)d\lambda$ 物体向周围发射辐射能的同时，也吸收周围物体的辐射能。辐射从外界入射到不透明物体时，一部分吸收，一部分反射（一部分透射） 单色吸收比$\alpha(\lambda,T)$在波长为$\lambda\sim\lambda+d\lambda$范围内的吸收比 任何温度下吸收比=1称为（绝对）黑体 $\dfrac{M_1(\lambda,T)}{\alpha_1(\lambda,T)}=\dfrac{M_2(\lambda,T)}{\alpha_2(\lambda,T)}=\cdots=M_0(\lambda,T),M_0(\lambda,T)是黑体单色辐出度$ 带小孔孔腔视为绝对黑体的模型 黑体辐射基本规律： 斯特藩-玻尔兹曼定律：$M_0(T)=\sigma T^4$，总辐出度$M_0(T)$ 维恩位移定律：$\lambda_mT=b$，单色辐出度的峰值波长$\lambda_m$ 普朗克能量子假说 普朗克公式：$M_0(\lambda,T)=2\pi hc2\lambda{-5}\dfrac1{e^{hc/k_BT\lambda}-1}$ 波长短/温度低的近似： 维恩公式：$M_0(\lambda,T)=2\pi hc2\lambda{-5}e^{-hc/k_BT\lambda}$ 波长高/温度高的近似： 瑞利-金斯公式：$M_0(\lambda,T)=2\pi k_Bc\lambda^{-4}T$ 普朗克假定：$谐振子能量值只取某个最小能量的整数倍\epsilon = h
